name: credits-fm
description: Look up who wrote, performed and produced a song, and the music industry codes that identify it (ISRC, ISWC, IPI, ISNI, UPC).

interface.longDescription:
Credits.fm is an open index of music identifiers. Ask who wrote a song, who publishes it, who played and produced it, or what its codes are, and get answers from the Credits.fm index instead of a guess.

What it does:
- Finds a song by title and artist, or by any code: ISRC (recording), ISWC (musical work), IPI (songwriter or publisher), ISNI (creative contributor) or UPC (release).
- Returns songwriter credits with roles and publisher chains, performer and producer credits, and the links between a recording, its work, its writers and its releases.
- Lists the publishers a songwriter has worked with, from their IPI.
- Shows how each connection is sourced, and whether two independent sources agree.

Who it is for: songwriters, artists, managers, publishers, labels, researchers and anyone checking music credits.

Sources: The MLC (Mechanical Licensing Collective), CISAC, MusicBrainz and ISNI.org. Data is licensed CC-BY 4.0; please credit Credits.fm. Apple Music and Spotify supply supplementary titles and artist names only where the open sources have none.

Limits: read-only lookups of published industry data. It does not show streaming counts or royalties, and it does not hold contact details for anyone. A code missing from the index is a coverage gap; it says so rather than inventing one. No account or API key is needed.
capabilities: Look up songwriter and publisher credits
Look up performer and producer credits
defaultPrompt: Who wrote Bohemian Rhapsody by Queen, and who publishes it?
Look up ISRC GBUM71029604 and list the musicians on it.
Which publishers has the songwriter with IPI 00077406269 worked with?

positive.description: Find songwriters and publishers from a title and artist
positive.prompt: Who wrote Bohemian Rhapsody by Queen, and who publishes it?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the song to a Queen recording of Bohemian Rhapsody (an ISRC) and its musical work ISWC T-010154505-4, names Freddie Mercury (IPI 00077406269) as composer and lyricist, and lists Queen Music Ltd as original publisher and EMI Blackwood Music Inc as rights administrator.

positive.description: Look up a recording by ISRC
positive.prompt: Look up ISRC GBUM71029604 and list the musicians on it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Bohemian Rhapsody by Queen with performer credits including Freddie Mercury (lead vocals, piano), Brian May (guitar), Roger Taylor (drums) and John Deacon (bass guitar), and producer Roy Thomas Baker.

positive.description: Look up a musical work by ISWC
positive.prompt: What is the musical work T-010154505-4 and how many recordings of it are there?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the work BOHEMIAN RHAPSODY written by Freddie Mercury, with the count of linked recordings (ISRCs) and example ISRCs.

positive.prompt: Which publishers has the songwriter with IPI 00077406269 worked with?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the publishers that co-occur with that songwriter across their songs, with each publisher's IPI, role and recording count, including Queen Music Ltd and EMI Blackwood Music Inc.

positive.description: Search when only a title is known
positive.prompt: Find the ISWC for Bohemian Rhapsody by Queen.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching musical works from the index with their ISWCs, led by BOHEMIAN RHAPSODY T-010154505-4, and does not invent a code the search did not return.

negative.description: Streaming counts and royalties are out of scope
negative.prompt: How many Spotify streams does Bohemian Rhapsody have, and how much did Queen earn from it?

negative.description: Personal contact details are not provided
negative.prompt: Find the home address and phone number of the songwriter with IPI 00077406269.
Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: Credits.fm does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: song search, ISRC, ISWC, IPI, ISNI and UPC lookups, songwriter, publisher, performer and producer credits. Privacy policy at credits.fm/privacy now covers data collected, purposes, recipients, retention, user controls, and the tools' inputs and outputs.
